subject: I-O status (action taken for fatal exception conditions)
notes: kb/Work PB322 determination E-extended LANDED (w1013m). A fatal I-O status (first digit 3, 4, 7, or a fatal 9x) with NO FILE STATUS clause, NO applicable USE procedure and no ON EXCEPTION phrase terminates the run unit abnormally: the statement's after-hook (EmitUseHook) ends in CobolFile.TerminateOnUncoveredFatalStatus, which throws a CobolFatalException naming the EC-I-O condition, the status, the file and the statement. GnuCOBOL (rule 1) terminates in the same case. The continue arms (FILE STATUS present, USE procedure ran, ON EXCEPTION phrase, SORT/MERGE implicit transfer under the verb's own rule) and the checking-enabled arm (EmitIoCheckEc, DOC-A.1-218) are unchanged. Witnesses: DocA1Item103WitnessTests (two terminations on different statements, four continuations); the NIST programs NC401M and ST146A, which depended on continuing, are recorded as divergent TERMINATES rows in tests/nist/corpus.tsv. retired-witness: conformance-test:DocA1Item103WitnessTests (a class-level ref does not resolve (SpecTraceabilityInventoryDriftTests wants Class.Method); the method-level witnesses replace it) retired-witness: conformance-test:DocA1Item218WitnessTests (a class-level ref does not resolve (SpecTraceabilityInventoryDriftTests wants Class.Method); the method-level witnesses replace it) | kb/Work PB2700 (w1041r): the SORT/MERGE implicit transfers now ask the same question - each as-if OPEN/READ/WRITE/CLOSE is performed 'as if' the statement 'had been executed' (14.9.40.4 GR12/GR15, 14.9.24.4 GR7/GR12), so a fatal status with no FILE STATUS clause, no USE procedure and no checking enabled ends the run unit (SortEmitter.EmitDisposition through SequentialIoEmitter.EmitUncoveredFatalTermination); the former carve-out 'a SORT or MERGE implicit transfer follows the verb's own rule' is removed from the determination. Witnesses: DocA1Item103WitnessTests SORT USING / MERGE USING / SORT GIVING (terminate) and the checked control; conformance:cases/14.9.24-MERGE/pb2700_sort_merge_missing_using_covered (covered arms).
